notes.title: FlopHop Demo Release: First Week and Three Updates!
notes.notes:
It’s been a week since the demo release, and you can play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3134890/Bunny_Space_Odyssey_FlopHop_Demo/?beta=1]it right HERE[/url]!
Over this week, we’ve released three updates thanks to your feedback and suggestions. We’re not planning to stop, and we hope the game will keep getting better.

It’s so exciting that you’re diving into Ponchee’s story and exploring the planet FlopHop. Every moment you spend in this world means so much to us. Your feedback and support are what make this journey possible, and we’re so happy to have you along for the ride. 

Thanks to everybunny!
